doc.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Chicago pianists, Tatum and talent versus practice
title: Sam Rivers and his wife Bea
summary: Both praise Sam Rivers's far-out music, and Freeman recalls staying with him in New York and his years on the scene.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Have you heard Sam’s big band?
I just . . .
Samski’s out there, baby.
We just did a record. Me and Joe were on it. This record got nominated for a Grammy, actually. I was shocked.
Listen, Samski is out there, baby.
I know, because that was one of the first people I hooked up with in New York.
I remember that.

He’s got some wild – Chico, as a matter of fact. Your son took me by the – he said, “Can you read?” I said, “Yeah, I read a little bit.” He said, “Come on over here. Let’s check out Sam – this guy Sam Rivers.” Man, I ain’t never heard no stuff like this in my life. I was like, what kind of . . .
I know, Samski, boy.
Like Mars music or something. It’s like the impact – it even had a bigger impact on me than something like Sun Ra. It was like, out there.
I know. He – wasn’t he on the fence last year?
He was here for a while, in Chicago, wasn’t he?
Yeah, Samski.
What was he – was he playing clubs and stuff, or what?
He was all over. Samski is doing it, baby.
You know he’s about the same age as you?
I know.
A lot of cats don’t think that, because of his style and what he’s associated with. He didn’t come to the fore until the ’60s.
When I go to New York, I stay with Chico. He’d always carry me to and from the gigs and to the airport.
Who, Sam?
Yeah.
I know he likes your playing a lot. He was talking – we’ve been talking about you.
He and I hit it right off, and Bea, boy, she is a treasure. She is a treasure. She really is.
She’s crazy. They’ve been together for a long time.
Ever since I can remember.
Because they told me – they were telling me that they had Charlie Parker over for dinner. I was like – that means you all have been together for a long time.
Yeah, past – I think it’s past 50 years.
Which is rare nowadays, especially for musicians.
Listen. Tell me about it.
Sam played with Dizzy too.
Right.
He made the rounds.
Listen, man, he’s excellent on flute.
Piano.
He plays a whole bunch of instruments.
